headline: Google SecOps 6.0.0 rewrites the Chronicle pack; a SaaS Claude connector splits into its own pack
summary_md:
- **GoogleChronicleBackstory** added 27,773 lines against 12 removed for "Google SecOps Release 6.0.0" — nine tenths of the day's churn on its own.
- **AnthropicClaudeStandardConnector** arrives as a new 306-line pack while **AnthropicClaude** drops 1,821 lines, the two halves of a SaaS connector split.
- **ApiModules** grew by 2,307 lines, the day's second-largest change.
- Integration fixes landed in **Mimecast**, **Doppel**, **Reco** and **Akamai_WAF**; **SpyCloudEnterpriseProtection** gained a new data type.
- 17 packs moved in total, from 12 upstream commits.

highlights.title: Google SecOps Release 6.0.0
highlights.detail: GoogleChronicleBackstory gained 27,773 lines and lost only 12, so this is a wholesale addition rather than a rewrite of what was there.

highlights.title: The Claude integration splits into a separate SaaS connector pack
highlights.detail: AnthropicClaudeStandardConnector is new at 306 lines while AnthropicClaude sheds 1,821 against 70 added, under the subject "saas claude connector".

highlights.title: Mimecast v2 migrates a command
highlights.detail: Mimecast churned hardest of any pack after the two above — 977 lines added against 730 removed — for a single command migration.

highlights.title: Doppel 1.1.0 fixes mirroring in both directions
highlights.detail: The pack added 1,765 lines and removed 265 to fix incoming and outgoing mirroring and add per-product entity content.

highlights.title: SpyCloud Enterprise Protection adds an Access Data type
highlights.detail: 578 lines added against 12 removed — a new data type rather than a fix to an existing one.

highlights.title: Reco stops fetch-incidents skipping alerts during bursts
highlights.detail: A 118-line fix to alert loss under load, which silently drops incidents rather than failing visibly.

items.Packs/GoogleChronicleBackstory: Google SecOps Release 6.0.0: 27,773 lines added against 12 removed.
items.Packs/ApiModules: Grew by 2,307 lines against 7 removed, the day's second-largest pack change.
items.Packs/AnthropicClaude: Lost 1,821 lines and gained 70 as the SaaS connector moved out into its own pack.
items.Packs/AnthropicClaudeStandardConnector: New pack, 306 lines, added under the subject "saas claude connector".
items.Packs/Doppel: Version 1.1.0 fixes incoming and outgoing mirroring and adds per-product entity content (+1,765/-265).
items.Packs/Mimecast: Mimecast v2 migrates a command; 977 lines added, 730 removed.
items.Packs/CheckPointHEC: Gained 316 lines against 38 removed; the day's one unclaimed subject changes fetch to key restore requests off the last fetched request.
items.Packs/Reco: Fixes fetch-incidents skipping alerts during bursts (+118/-14).
items.Packs/CortexXDR: Twelve lines added for the Cortex update-issue action migration.
